production_saved_generations.caveat: the app keeps at most 60 generations on disk and prunes older ones, so earlier production generations are not in the logs; their count is unknown.

earlier_pilot_eval_generation.interpretation: fallback rate is the share NOT written by the first Cloudflare writer model; 0.0 means all 15 briefs were written by that Cloudflare model. Per-brief model names were not saved.

review_log_decisions.note: the log stores decision, brief and texts but not the writer model

benchmark_runs.source: eval/runs/*.jsonl (backend and model recorded per row)
benchmark_runs.note: forced to local Ollama by run_benchmark.py; not production traffic
